$comment: Gate eval set. Each case has hand-collected evidence signals and a reference review (what a careful reviewer concludes from that evidence). `pnpm eval:gates` scores the gate decisions against the labels; `--live` asks the configured model for the review instead. Signals are approximate snapshots, not live data.
